metadata.source: Research compilation — Wikidata Q-IDs verified via wikidata.org API
metadata.description: Diverse expansion batch — Korean history, uncovered world figures, and additional works. Targets regions with zero coverage to reach 3,000+ entities.

figures.name: Yi Sun-sin
figures.title: Korean naval commander
figures.description: Korea's greatest naval hero who invented the turtle ship and won 23 consecutive naval victories against Japan's Toyotomi invasion fleet

figures.name: Sejong the Great
figures.title: Fourth King of Joseon
figures.description: Korea's most revered monarch who created the Hangul alphabet, promoted science and agriculture, and expanded territory

figures.name: Gwanggaeto the Great
figures.title: King of Goguryeo
figures.description: The greatest conqueror king of Goguryeo who expanded the kingdom to its largest territorial extent across Manchuria and the Korean Peninsula

figures.name: King Dongmyeong
figures.title: Founder of Goguryeo
figures.description: Legendary founder of the Goguryeo kingdom, one of the Three Kingdoms of Korea, said to have been the son of a river god

figures.name: Kim Yushin
figures.title: Korean general
figures.description: The greatest general of the Silla kingdom who united the Three Kingdoms of Korea through military conquest and diplomatic alliances

figures.name: Empress Myeongseong
figures.title: Empress of Korea
figures.description: The last empress of Korea who resisted Japanese encroachment and was assassinated by Japanese agents in the Eulmi Incident

figures.name: Heo Jun
figures.title: Korean royal physician
figures.description: Court physician who compiled the Dongui Bogam, a foundational text of Korean medicine recognized by UNESCO as a Memory of the World

figures.name: Haile Selassie
figures.title: Emperor of Ethiopia
figures.description: Last emperor of Ethiopia who modernized the country, addressed the League of Nations against Italian aggression, and became a messianic figure in Rastafarianism

figures.name: Hurrem Sultan
figures.title: Ottoman Empress
figures.description: Born as Roxelana, a Ruthenian slave who became the legal wife of Suleiman the Magnificent and the most powerful woman in Ottoman history

figures.name: Hayreddin Barbarossa
figures.title: Ottoman admiral
figures.description: The greatest admiral of the Ottoman navy who dominated the Mediterranean, turning it into an Ottoman lake and terrorizing European coastal cities

figures.name: Sappho
figures.title: Greek lyric poet
figures.description: Greatest female poet of antiquity whose passionate love poems from the island of Lesbos survived only in fragments but influenced all subsequent Western lyric poetry

figures.name: James Cook
figures.title: British explorer and navigator
figures.description: Explorer who made three Pacific voyages mapping New Zealand, Australia's eastern coast, and Hawaii, advancing navigation science before being killed by Hawaiians

figures.name: Boudica
figures.title: Queen of the Iceni
figures.description: British Celtic queen who led a massive revolt against Roman occupation, burning Londinium and killing 70,000 before her final defeat

figures.name: Josephine Baker
figures.title: Dancer, singer, and activist
figures.description: American-born French entertainer who became the most famous dancer in Europe, a French Resistance hero, and a civil rights activist who adopted 12 children

figures.name: Cleopatra Selene II
figures.title: Queen of Mauretania
figures.description: Daughter of Cleopatra VII and Mark Antony who survived the fall of Ptolemaic Egypt to become queen of Mauretania, bringing Hellenistic culture to North Africa

figures.name: Dae Joyeong
figures.title: Founder of Balhae
figures.description: Goguryeo general who founded the kingdom of Balhae after the fall of Goguryeo, establishing a powerful successor state in Manchuria

figures.name: Jang Yeong-sil
figures.title: Korean scientist and inventor
figures.description: Born into the slave class but rose to become Korea's greatest inventor, creating the world's first rain gauge, astronomical instruments, and water clocks under King Sejong

figures.name: Gwon Yul
figures.title: Korean general
figures.description: Commander who won the crucial Battle of Haengju during the Japanese invasions, defending a hill fortress with vastly outnumbered forces

figures.name: Non-gae
figures.title: Korean patriot
figures.description: Gisaeng who sacrificed her life by embracing a Japanese general and leaping off a cliff into the Nam River during the Japanese invasion, becoming a Korean national heroine

figures.name: An Jung-geun
figures.title: Korean independence activist
figures.description: Korean patriot who assassinated Japanese statesman Ito Hirobumi at Harbin station in 1909, becoming a revered independence hero in Korea

works.title: Dae Jang Geum
works.creator: Lee Byung-hoon
works.description: Korean historical drama about a female physician who overcomes adversity to become the first woman to serve as the Korean king's doctor

works.title: Magnificent Century
works.creator: Meral Okay
works.description: Turkish historical drama depicting the reign of Suleiman the Magnificent and his love for Hurrem Sultan, becoming one of the most-watched series worldwide

works.title: Invictus
works.creator: Clint Eastwood
works.description: Film about Nelson Mandela's use of the 1995 Rugby World Cup to unite post-apartheid South Africa, starring Morgan Freeman

works.title: Selma
works.creator: Ava DuVernay
works.description: Drama depicting Martin Luther King Jr.'s campaign to secure equal voting rights via the Selma to Montgomery marches of 1965

works.title: The Death of Stalin
works.creator: Armando Iannucci
works.description: Dark comedy depicting the power struggle among Soviet leaders following Stalin's death in 1953

works.title: Hotel Rwanda
works.creator: Terry George
works.description: True story of a hotel manager who housed over a thousand Tutsi refugees during the Rwandan genocide, sheltering them from the Hutu militias

works.title: The Last Temptation of Christ
works.creator: Martin Scorsese
works.description: Controversial adaptation of Kazantzakis's novel imagining Jesus experiencing human desires and doubts, exploring the dual nature of Christ

works.title: Twelve Years a Slave (memoir)
works.creator: Solomon Northup
works.description: Autobiography of a free Black man kidnapped and sold into slavery in Louisiana, one of the most detailed accounts of American slavery from a firsthand perspective

works.title: The Color Purple
works.creator: Alice Walker
works.description: Pulitzer Prize-winning epistolary novel about an African-American woman's struggle against racism and sexism in the rural South

works.title: The Color Purple (film)
works.creator: Steven Spielberg
works.description: Film adaptation of Alice Walker's novel, starring Whoopi Goldberg and Oprah Winfrey in their breakout roles

works.title: Roots (novel)
works.creator: Alex Haley
works.description: Groundbreaking novel tracing an African-American family from its ancestor Kunta Kinte's capture in West Africa through slavery, the Civil War, and Reconstruction

works.title: The Kite Runner
works.creator: Khaled Hosseini
works.description: Novel about friendship, betrayal, and redemption set against the backdrop of Afghan history from the fall of the monarchy to the Taliban era

works.title: Shogun (TV 1980)
works.creator: Jerry London
works.description: Groundbreaking television miniseries based on James Clavell's novel, one of the first Western productions to portray feudal Japan in depth

works.title: The Handmaid's Tale
works.creator: Bruce Miller
works.description: Dystopian drama based on Margaret Atwood's novel about a totalitarian theocracy that has reduced women to servitude

works.title: Chernobyl
works.creator: Craig Mazin
works.description: HBO miniseries dramatizing the 1986 nuclear disaster, depicting the heroism and institutional failures that turned a reactor accident into a catastrophe

works.title: The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
works.creator: Mark Twain
works.description: Great American novel about a boy and an escaped slave rafting down the Mississippi River, a masterwork of satire on racism and American society

works.title: Don Quixote
works.creator: Miguel de Cervantes
works.description: The first modern novel, following a delusional knight-errant and his loyal squire Sancho Panza across Spain, a masterwork that invented the form

works.title: Les Miserables
works.creator: Victor Hugo
works.description: Epic French novel following the ex-convict Jean Valjean through decades of French history, from Waterloo to the 1832 June Rebellion in Paris

works.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
works.creator: Gabriel Garcia Marquez
works.description: Landmark novel of magical realism following seven generations of the Buendia family in the fictional town of Macondo, Colombia

works.title: The Tale of Genji
works.creator: Murasaki Shikibu
works.description: Often called the world's first novel, this masterpiece of Japanese literature chronicles the life and loves of Prince Genji in the Heian court

works.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
works.creator: Alexandre Dumas
works.description: Epic adventure novel about an innocent man imprisoned for 14 years who escapes, discovers a vast treasure, and methodically destroys those who wronged him

works.title: Ivanhoe
works.creator: Walter Scott
works.description: The novel that invented the historical fiction genre, set in 12th-century England during the conflict between Saxons and Normans after the Third Crusade

works.title: The Three Musketeers
works.creator: Alexandre Dumas
works.description: Swashbuckling adventure of d'Artagnan and his three musketeer companions in the political intrigues of 17th-century France under Louis XIII and Cardinal Richelieu

works.title: I, Claudius (novel)
works.creator: Robert Graves
works.description: Fictional autobiography of Roman Emperor Claudius, narrating the political intrigues, murders, and madness of the Julio-Claudian dynasty

properties.notes: Yi Sun-sin era overlaps with Jewel in the Palace setting
Murasaki Shikibu is the author and the narrator is her fictional creation
Ito Hirobumi represents Japanese imperial threat in the Korean drama era
